messages.content:
I’m here—how can I help?

Quick options (pick one to start, and I’ll route you to the right specialist):
- Define or refine your product mission and success metrics → Product Strategist
- Establish an architecture baseline (services, interfaces, data model) → Solutions Architect
- Generate/clean up API specs (OAS) from your interfaces → API/OAS Engineer
- Build a 90-day roadmap (initiatives/epics) → Roadmap Planner
- Seed a prioritized backlog (top 10 user stories) → Backlog Curator
- Define test strategy and release criteria → QA Planner

If you want my recommendation on next steps, tell me:
- Do you already have a mission/vision? (yes/no)
- Any existing architecture model or interface filenames? (if yes, share names)
- Do you have a roadmap or backlog started? (yes/no)
- Your projectId and, if saving artifacts, the project root path

Based on your answers, I’ll prioritize the next 2–3 actions and get the right persona engaged.

questions: What is the project or product name you want to use?
Is this a new product or an existing product?
Do you have any existing documentation (PRD, brief, deck, notes) that we should reference? If yes, please share or summarize.
In one sentence, what core problem are we solving?
structuredResponse.summary: Starting structured discovery: I need the product name, whether it’s new or existing, any existing docs, and a one-sentence statement of the core problem.
